question: What truthful account of the outcaste woman will be declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker directly addresses the goddess.
The speaker promises to declare the outcaste woman.
The declaration is to be made as things truly are.
inference: Therefore, the goddess is to receive a truthful exposition concerning the outcaste woman.
uncertainties: antyajā is taken as the topic or object of declaration though morphologically nominative singular.
plain_english: O goddess, listen; I shall declare the outcaste woman as she truly is.
